findings.claim: _check_examples_cover_matrix's key regex is line-anchored, so an EXAMPLES entry not starting its own line is silently dropped from the parsed set; every consequence produced fails in the safe direction (red, or caught by the rendered form case), so this is a robustness note, not a gap.
findings.evidence: src/browser/eval_adapter.py _check_examples_cover_matrix: re.findall(r'^\s*"([^"]+)":\s*\{', block, re.M) and page.split('const EXAMPLES = {',1)[1]. Scratch results on 18f682b: added doc row → red; renamed row → red both directions; 'const EXAMPLES={' reformat → IndexError recorded as passed=False (loud); escaped quote in a key → red; a second key appended mid-line → not parsed (passes only because it also has no row; a real-site row's example written mid-line goes red as rows_without_example).
findings.repro: Scratch copy; append ', "zz.example": {label: "a"' to the books line of EXAMPLES; run_case(ui-examples-cover-matrix) → passed True (zz.example unseen); put a real row's key mid-line → passed False.
findings.acceptance: No action required for M35; if the EXAMPLES block is ever reformatted, the check should parse the object rather than line starts.
